name: lowrymiami
caption:
WHAT DID LOWRY GET US? 🎮🏀 Kyle Lowry left us in a sign-and-trade. Look what it turned into.

• Lowry's last season with us (2020-21): 17.2 PPG, 7.3 APG
• Aug 6, 2021: sign-and-trade to Miami for Goran Dragic (5 games with us) and Precious Achiuwa
• Dec 30, 2023: Achiuwa goes to New York in the OG trade that brings us RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley
• RJ, first 12 games: 21.3 PPG. IQ, 10 games: 17.6 PPG
• July 7, 2026: Lowry signs a one-day deal to retire with us

Letting Lowry go: right call or mistake? 👇

facts.claim: On August 6, 2021 (Aug 6) Miami signed Lowry via a sign-and-trade with the Raptors for Goran Dragic and Precious Achiuwa; NBA All-Star 2015-2020 (6x); 2020-21 his final year in Toronto; on July 7, 2026 he signed a one-day contract to retire with the Raptors
On December 30, 2023 (Dec 30) Achiuwa was traded with OG Anunoby and Malachi Flynn to the Knicks for RJ Barrett, Immanuel Quickley and a second-round pick
